title: Review AI-generated code
summary: An assistant produced three small functions. Review them like a senior engineer: find the problems, explain them and say how you would fix and test them.

requirements.text: You identified at least three different problems in the code.
For each problem you explained what goes wrong, and under what input or situation.
For each problem you described a fix in your own words.
You described how you would test each fix, including at least one edge case.
You wrote the instruction you would give an AI assistant to fix the code, with context and constraints.
